model_annotations.English: Figure 8(c) is a bar chart that illustrates the branching ratio (β) for different numbers of few-shot examples. The 'Baseline' bar is the tallest, indicating the highest branching ratio, while the 'Explanatory' bar is the shortest, indicating the lowest branching ratio. The 'Demonstration' bar falls in between the two. The chart is part of a larger analysis of the impact of different prompting styles on the performance of a reasoning model, as discussed in the accompanying text.
